hypothesis: Timeless directional calls are significantly better in UP regime (100% win) than RANGE (33% win). Regime filtering improves his signal.
economic_mechanism: Tactical directional calls work best when the market is trending. In range-bound markets, mean reversion dominates and directional calls get chopped.
falsification: If UP-regime win rate drops below 70% with n>10, reject regime filter.
key_finding: Timeless is 3x better in UP regime (100% vs 33% in RANGE). Regime filter is the activation rule.
